title: What does Mr Sidney Lee, or Mr Simon Lazarus as some aver his name is, say of it?
html_source: Sidney Lee (1859-1926) was an eminent scholar & biographer of Shakespeare. He, like Brandes, was of Jewish descent & born Solomon [not Simon] Lazarus Levi. That both Brandes & Lee have changed their names and are lapsed Jews plays a part in the book’s outsider theme.
